##### Project general facts

One Za'abeel Residences is a truly iconic address, a striking 57-storey tower that brings together the very best of modern living within one of the most ambitious landmark developments ever created. The tower is home to 264 opulent residences, thoughtfully composed as a mix of elegant simplexes and dramatic duplexes for those who expect something extraordinary from their home. Buyers can choose from beautifully planned two, three and four bedroom apartments, crowned by a magnificent five bedroom penthouse at the very top.

Residents enjoy an exceptional lifestyle offering anchored by The Link, a spectacular panoramic sky podium suspended 100 metres above ground that dissects the two towers and sets a world record as the longest cantilevered building. Here you will find panoramic viewing decks, a stunning swimming pool with breathtaking views, Michelin-inspired restaurants, refined lounges and a celebrity chef events programme, alongside a dedicated health and wellness spa and fitness retreat. The development is further elevated by the presence of the luxurious One&Only urban resort, a captivating collection of high-end retail and dining venues, executive concierge services, generous parking with valet, and round-the-clock security.

Inside, every residence has been exquisitely planned to create luxury living spaces that feel both uplifting and effortlessly elegant. The interiors are defined by distinctive architectural features, luxury designer fittings and beautifully crafted detailing throughout, with duplex layouts making the most of soaring double-height volumes. Expansive floor-to-ceiling glazing frames sweeping 360-degree panoramas, filling each home with natural light and offering perspectives that few addresses in the world can match.

##### Location description and benefits 

DIFC Zabeel District is a urban extension of the Dubai International Financial Centre, positioned at the intersection of Dubai’s most established business, lifestyle, and residential destinations. Strategically located between DIFC, Downtown Dubai, Zabeel Park, and the World Trade Centre corridor, the district benefits from direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and key city arteries. This prime positioning places residents within minutes of Dubai’s financial core, cultural landmarks, and global business hubs, while maintaining a sense of exclusivity and urban refinement.

The district is conceived as a fully integrated, mixed-use urban quarter that seamlessly blends residential, commercial, retail, and lifestyle components. Thoughtfully planned pedestrian routes, shaded boulevards, landscaped public spaces, and curated retail and dining destinations form the backbone of the neighborhood. The master plan emphasizes walkability, connectivity, and a human-scale urban experience, transforming DIFC Zabeel District into a vibrant, self-sustained environment that supports both professional and everyday living.

DIFC Zabeel District is designed to cater to a cosmopolitan audience seeking a dynamic yet balanced lifestyle. The area combines the prestige and global reputation of DIFC with contemporary urban living, offering proximity to offices, cultural venues, hospitality, and leisure destinations within a single cohesive district. With its emphasis on quality placemaking, integrated amenities, and long-term urban value, DIFC Zabeel District is positioned as one of Dubai’s most forward-looking and desirable central neighborhoods.
